_about: Every gate number of the strategy pipeline (docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-07-strategy-pipeline-design.md; `bp.py pipe`), read by blueprint/pipe_rules.py: need(*keys). Shares and odds are fractions. `card` = what a pipeline card may hold (ways, values a way, indicators, bar sizes, markets, sessions: the evening session is not in this version). `raw` = the raw heat map of stage 1: `strict` is the law's own bar (lines 2.1, 2.2, 2.4), `low` the wider door (a smaller share and half the floor, held to more trades); `floor_part` = the part of line 2.2's cost floor the average trade must reach. `indicator` = stage 3 (`other_markets` = the share of the other markets that must agree). `proof` = stage 4: `reshuffle` is line 2.8's share of the runs; `random_alpha` makes the random bar, 1 - alpha / tries, the law's ladder of line 2.3 carried on past round 5. `box` = the best days taken out at the lock and on the test (lines 3.8, 4.6). `prop` = the 30-day prop odds of one strategy; `portfolio` = the bar a portfolio is built to. A number the law also carries (raw.strict.share = 2.1, raw.strict.trades = 2.4, proof.reshuffle = 2.8, the random bar = 2.3 to 3 decimals, box.best_days_share = 3.8 and 4.6) must be the same here and in rules.json: pipe_rules.py refuses to load when they differ. A change here is a change of the pipeline's rules: it needs the owner's word. Locked by tests/test_pipe_rules.py.
